Class ByteCodeWriterTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.ByteCodeWriterTck
public abstract class ByteCodeWriterTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
The behaviour every bytecode backend must provide, asserted through the classes a backend writes rather than through the bytecode it emits, so that the same tests hold for any backend.

A backend runs the TCK by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(ObjectDef). Assertions about a particular backend's encoding, such as the exact instructions it selects or the fallbacks it offers, belong in that backend's own tests.

Since:
2.2
